# Pilot studies of bioremediation of Exxon Valdez oil, Prince William Sound beaches, 2010-2011 (metadata only)

DataONE PID df35f.14.20 (member node urn:node:GOA, Gulf of Alaska Data Portal / EVOSTC). Fetched 14 Nov 2026 from
https://cn.dataone.org/cn/v2/resolve/df35f.14.20 (EML 2.1.1 metadata only).

**The data tables were NOT obtained.** The EML lists eleven CSV entities (beachesSurveyed, beachesWithLingeringOil, lingeringOilLevels [pit oil levels],
qualRank, dissolvedOxygen, islandNutrientLevels, MPNProcessed, TPH, compConc, compConcTPH, biomarkConc; PIDs df35f.12.1, .13.1, .16.1, .18.1, .52.2, .53.1, .54.2, .55.2, .59.2, .60.2, .61.2).
Every one returned HTTP 401 "READ not allowed ... for subject public" from the DataONE coordinating node on 14 Nov 2026, so they were not downloaded. No workaround was tried.
Why it matters: it is a field bioremediation trial (oxygen + nutrient delivery) on lingering-oil gravel beaches with before/after TPAH, i.e. treatment evidence for coarse beaches.
Lawful route: ask the EVOSTC / Gulf of Alaska Data Portal data manager or the project authors for the CSVs.
